status: PROMOTED into verdant_v0_2.json on 2026-10-02 (AGENT_CHAT 15:18Z). Kept as the record of candidate v1; applying it to the current baseline changes nothing except restating values.
description: Rich's eight preferred bootstrap rules. The open numbers use the least generous value from the bounded sweep (candidate_bootstrap_sweep.json) wherever a more generous value made no material difference. No tested setting completes the Memory Reef.

decisions.1_first_stable: Nutrient Washer, Clean-Flow Node and a new basic Waste Collector use General labour. Channel Separator and Waste Digester stay Adapted.
decisions.2_kiln_clinic: The first Ceramic Kiln uses Adapted labour (later Kilns need Artisans). The first Detox Clinic costs no Habitat Composite. Health stays a Symbiotic gate.
decisions.3_memory: The first Memory Circle uses Artisan labour; later Circles need Coordinators.
decisions.4_enzyme: The first Silicate Pit costs no Repair Enzyme. The Carbonate Cutter keeps its Enzyme cost, and maintenance demands Enzyme.
decisions.5_carbonate: The Carbonate Cutter runs before Mineral Jaw at 50% (same pattern as the Silicate Pit); Mineral Jaw gives full rate.
decisions.6_growth_nutrient: High Water slows sediment extraction instead of closing it; the no-Burrowing Dredge penalty is softened.
decisions.7_builders: A Builder allocation reserves General workers (higher classes may substitute) whenever a site is ready for work, staffed after services and before food crews. The sweep showed builders ranked after food never get workers (no Stable in any of 48 runs).
decisions.8_maintenance: Upkeep (1 Enzyme per 10 weight per 8 min) is enforced after a grace period that ends at the first Symbiotic home; ending it at the first Stable left Maintenance unpaid for an average of 20 minutes and blocked evolution. The colony starts with a small Enzyme reserve.
